definitions.READY: booted from its own recipe, got a real UI response, at least one screen was browser-verified (rendered, not just HTTP 200), AND at least one capability was PROVEN by a real in-browser action - not source inspection.
definitions.NOT_VERIFIED_vs_PASS: a capability with an attach point but no live UI exercise, or a live action with no code attach point, is NOT VERIFIED - never PASS.

known_environment_constraint: This sandbox's egress policy denies ghcr.io, quay.io, and OS package mirrors (deb.debian.org, Alpine's apk mirrors) outright, confirmed by direct request. Any app whose install needs one of those is recorded BLOCKED_EXTERNAL_DEPENDENCY, per spec section 15 - this is an infrastructure ceiling of this sandbox, not a defect in the pipeline.
